Brain stacking is all over TikTok: back-to-back puzzles, reading and journalling to build a better brain.

A Swansea University psychologist writing in The Conversation this month said there's little evidence it boosts brainpower. Getting better at a puzzle mostly makes you better at that puzzle. The enjoyment is real, which is why number 6 stays.

The Aviva 2025 sleep survey found 59% of us are kept awake by a busy mind. That's a better place to start than another app.

Do you do a daily puzzle? Wordle counts.

Save this for your next overthinking evening, and send it to the friend with five brain-training apps.
